# Copilot instructions

Project context lives in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) — authorities, commands,
architecture, patterns, and the Definition of Done. Read it before suggesting
code.

Two things worth repeating because they are easy to get wrong here:

- **This site is a drawn figure sheet, not a component-library layout.** The
  visual system in DESIGN.md is binding: zero radius, no shadows, a five-weight
  line hierarchy, one annotation colour. Do not reach for cards, gradients, or
  glow, and do not assume shadcn/ui components are available — only `button.tsx`
  remains.
- **Nothing on this site may be fabricated.** PRODUCT.md governs what may be
  claimed. Do not invent metrics, dates, drawing numbers, or capability
  statements to fill a layout.
